label: Party
assignment_rationale: Foundational contextual participant role used across identity interactions.

label: IdentitySubject
assignment_rationale: Defines what identity representation or identity information is about.

label: DigitalIdentity
assignment_rationale: Canonical managed digital representation of an IdentitySubject.

label: Identifier
assignment_rationale: Foundational scoped reference/sign used across profiles.

label: IdentityContext
assignment_rationale: Defines interpretation context for identity representations; distinct from operational/security domains.

label: IdentityAttribute
assignment_rationale: Identity-information element about a subject.

label: Claim
assignment_rationale: Assertion about an IdentitySubject; reused by credentials and exchange.

label: Evidence
assignment_rationale: Cross-context evidential role supporting claims, bindings and assessments.

label: Proof
assignment_rationale: Specialized evidential role for verification/proof use.

label: IdentityBinding
assignment_rationale: Relator grounding subject-to-representation/credential/authenticator bindings.

label: Credential
assignment_rationale: Credential lifecycle ownership belongs to Credential Management.

label: CredentialStatus
assignment_rationale: Credential lifecycle/status semantics.

label: CredentialLifecycleEvent
assignment_rationale: Generic credential lifecycle event.

label: CredentialIssuance
assignment_rationale: Credential issuance event owned by lifecycle domain.

label: IdentityProofing
assignment_rationale: Establishes confidence before or while creating a managed identity relationship.

label: Enrollment
assignment_rationale: Creates managed identity relationship; distinct from provisioning.

label: Authentication
assignment_rationale: Authentication process semantics.

label: Authenticator
assignment_rationale: Contextual authentication role; devices may play it without being defined by it.

label: AuthenticationResult
assignment_rationale: Authentication outcome; distinct from Session.

label: AssuranceAssessment
assignment_rationale: Cross-dimensional evidence-backed assurance assessment.

label: Authorization
assignment_rationale: Authorization evaluation process.

label: AuthorizationRequest
assignment_rationale: Authorization request information object.

label: AuthorizationContext
assignment_rationale: Environmental/request context for access decisions.

label: AuthorizationResult
assignment_rationale: Explicit authorization decision artifact.

label: Principal
assignment_rationale: Authorization role played by heterogeneous actors/representations.

label: Resource
assignment_rationale: Protected-target role.

label: Action
assignment_rationale: Requested operation specification.

label: Permission
assignment_rationale: Normative access unit.

label: AccessGrant
assignment_rationale: Durable assignment distinct from runtime decision.

label: Delegation
assignment_rationale: Delegated authority semantics used especially by agent scenarios.

label: TrustAssessment
assignment_rationale: Trust assessment is distinct from cryptographic validation and conformance status.

label: TrustReference
assignment_rationale: Alignment/reference hook to external trust constructs.

label: RelyingParty
assignment_rationale: Primary ownership in cross-domain relying interactions; reused in credential and authentication scenarios.

label: Verifier
assignment_rationale: Generic verification role; concrete exchange/authentication verifier roles specialize by context.

label: Account
assignment_rationale: Platform-local managed identity representation.

label: UserProfile
assignment_rationale: Mutable managed identity information record.

label: IdentitySource
assignment_rationale: Operational source of identity information.

label: AuthoritativeIdentitySource
assignment_rationale: Source authoritative for specified identity information.

label: IdentityStore
assignment_rationale: Managed repository/service for identity data.

label: AdministrativeDomain
assignment_rationale: Operational administration boundary, distinct from IdentityContext.

label: Application
assignment_rationale: Managed software entity that may play identity interaction roles.

label: ApplicationRegistration
assignment_rationale: Configuration record for an application/client in an identity domain.

label: Federation
assignment_rationale: Cross-domain identity relationship.

label: FederationConnection
assignment_rationale: Configured federation relationship.

label: IdentityBroker
assignment_rationale: Intermediary role mediating identity/authentication flows across domains.

label: Provisioning
assignment_rationale: Creates, updates or synchronizes platform-local representations; not Enrollment.

label: ProvisioningConnection
assignment_rationale: Configured source-target provisioning relationship.

label: AttributeMapping
assignment_rationale: Operational mapping artifact for claims/attributes.

label: Session
assignment_rationale: Temporally bounded post-authentication security context.

label: PermissionBundle
assignment_rationale: Operational grouping of Core Permissions.

label: AccessPolicy
assignment_rationale: Detailed policy artifact retained outside minimal Core semantics.

label: AccessCondition
assignment_rationale: Predicate or condition used in authorization evaluation.

label: AccessGroup
assignment_rationale: Operational access grouping; not a social-identity group.

label: GroupMembership
assignment_rationale: Operational membership mediating access assignment.

label: Issuer
assignment_rationale: Contextual credential-issuing role.

label: Holder
assignment_rationale: Credential holding/control role; not necessarily subject.

label: CredentialPresentationVerifier
assignment_rationale: Verifier role specialized for credential presentations.

label: Wallet
assignment_rationale: Software role managing or presenting credentials.

label: HolderService
assignment_rationale: Service role supporting holder credential operations.

label: CredentialPresentation
assignment_rationale: Presentation event distinct from Authentication.

label: PresentationRequest
assignment_rationale: Request artifact for credential-derived information.

label: Controller
assignment_rationale: Role controlling identifier or verification material.

label: VerificationMethod
assignment_rationale: Verification artifact used in credential/identifier ecosystems.

label: VerifiableDataRegistry
assignment_rationale: Registry or service supporting status, schema, identifier or trusted-entity information.

label: SelectiveDisclosure
assignment_rationale: Presentation capability controlling disclosed information.

label: VerifiablePresentation
assignment_rationale: Presentation artifact carrying selected claims and proofs.

label: Workload
assignment_rationale: Runtime compute entity capable of subject and principal roles.

label: RuntimeInstance
assignment_rationale: Concrete execution instance.

label: ServiceAccount
assignment_rationale: Non-human account representation used by workloads or automation.

label: ServicePrincipal
assignment_rationale: Workload or application principal role.

label: ManagedIdentity
assignment_rationale: Provider-managed workload identity pattern.

label: Device
assignment_rationale: Device entity independent of its identity record, credential or authenticator role.

label: DeviceIdentityRecord
assignment_rationale: Managed representation or record of a Device.

label: NodeAttestation
assignment_rationale: Attestation event supporting workload identity establishment.

label: WorkloadAttestation
assignment_rationale: Attestation event identifying requesting workload.

label: TrustDomain
assignment_rationale: Workload identity namespace or security boundary; not TrustFramework.

label: TrustBundle
assignment_rationale: Verification material for workload trust domain.

label: SVID
assignment_rationale: SPIFFE credential specialization.

label: TemporaryCredential
assignment_rationale: Short-lived credential used in workload or federated operations.

label: TokenExchange
assignment_rationale: Credential or security-context exchange event.

label: SoftwareAgent
assignment_rationale: Goal-directed software entity capable of identity and principal roles.

label: AIAgent
assignment_rationale: AI-driven SoftwareAgent specialization.

label: AgentIdentity
assignment_rationale: Managed digital identity representation specialized for an agent.

label: AgentSponsor
assignment_rationale: Accountability or governance role responsible for agent identity lifecycle.

label: TrustFramework
assignment_rationale: Governed normative framework for ecosystem trust conditions.

label: GovernanceFramework
assignment_rationale: Institutional operating and conformance framework.

label: TrustRegistry
assignment_rationale: Governed registry of participants, providers or trust status.

label: TrustedList
assignment_rationale: Governed trusted-entity or service list.

label: TrustAnchor
assignment_rationale: Root or terminus role for a trust chain.

label: TrustChain
assignment_rationale: Structured path of trust statements, certificates or entity statements.

label: GovernanceAuthority
assignment_rationale: Role defining or enforcing governance rules.

label: Registrar
assignment_rationale: Role registering ecosystem participants or services.

label: Regulator
assignment_rationale: Oversight or regulatory role.

label: ConformityAssessmentBody
assignment_rationale: Independent conformance-assessment role.

label: Certification
assignment_rationale: Governance process establishing certified status.

label: Accreditation
assignment_rationale: Governance process establishing assessment competence or authority.

label: EcosystemParticipation
assignment_rationale: Governed participant-framework relationship.

label: ParticipantStatus
assignment_rationale: Status of governed ecosystem participation.

label: LegalIdentity
assignment_rationale: Legally recognized identity construct used in government or legal contexts.

label: PersonIdentificationData
assignment_rationale: Governed person-identification data set.

label: GovernmentAttestation
assignment_rationale: Government or regulated attestation about a subject.

label: IdentityServiceProvider
assignment_rationale: Governed provider role supplying identity services.
